checks.name: Design lint
checks.method: Executable source lint plus rendered review against the selected project grammar.
checks.evidence: TASTE-007 through TASTE-013 passed across five UI files with zero findings; manual review also covered TASTE-014.

checks.name: Pure ranking and feedback behavior
checks.method: Jest unit tests and an exact touched-file TypeScript project.
checks.evidence: lib/semantic: 19 suites and 103 tests passed. Feedback mapping/receipt: 3 tests passed. Scoped tsc completed with no diagnostics.

checks.name: Live semantic path
checks.method: Authenticated local browser and loopback Qdrant using the frozen evaluation corpus.
checks.evidence: Near, Balanced, and Far each ranked 1,500 candidates and rendered 24 results; observed server search latency was approximately 0.23 to 0.35 seconds per mode.

checks.name: Feedback persistence and privacy
checks.method: Browser save/undo followed by direct-Postgres catalog and row checks.
checks.evidence: Save persisted saved|balanced|1; undo returned the table to zero rows. RLS is enabled, anon/authenticated SELECT and INSERT are revoked, and the validated tracked-channel FK cascades on delete.

checks.name: Responsive and degraded states
checks.method: Rendered captures at wide and narrow viewports plus a real unreachable-Qdrant run.
checks.evidence: No horizontal overflow at 1440x900 or 390x844. The local-vector outage rendered the retryable offline state without taking down the app.

states.name: far-actions
states.notes: Far mode with result evidence and reversible actions in view.

states.name: semantic-offline
states.notes: Qdrant deliberately pointed at an unreachable loopback port.

states.name: saved-and-undone
states.notes: A live save was persisted, shown as pressed, then removed through the same control.

accessibility_evidence.method: Interactive snapshot and keyboard traversal in the narrow and wide renders.
accessibility_evidence.evidence: Target selector, distance radios, submit control, result links, and save/dismiss controls are native focusable elements with the existing visible focus treatment.
Distance modes are labeled radios; selected feedback changes text and aria-pressed; unavailable and missing-index states use explicit text.
One page heading, labeled controls, semantic result articles, definition lists for evidence, time elements, descriptive thumbnail alt text, and explicit external-link labels are present.

remaining_risks: The experiment covers only the frozen 9,385-video and 3,544-channel corpus.
Far means furthest among the 1,500 nearest retrieved candidates, not the entire library.
Save and dismiss are product feedback, not validated creative-transfer labels or learned ranking weights.
Repository-wide tsc remains red on pre-existing legacy and stale .next/type errors outside the touched-file project.
The black Next.js development-toolbar button visible in captures is not product UI.
